checks.must: React reads from and writes through the shared app.todos collection (subscribing to its events), rather than copying todos into React state + fetch, so SidebarView's count and 'clear done' stay in sync both ways.
Backbone event listeners added for React are removed on unmount (off/stopListening).
Toggling still saves with patch:true via the model (PATCH request with only 'done').
Rendering order follows the collection comparator 'order'.
Titles remain escaped (React default) — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML with raw titles.
No unrequested behaviour changes (e.g. rollback on failed save, optimistic UI changes) without calling them out.
